serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
Facility Grid is a multi-tenant SaaS platform for construction commissioning, quality control and turnover. Commissioning agents, general contractors and building owners use it to plan and record commissioning work on new and renovated buildings: equipment and system inventories, installation checklists, functional performance tests, issues and observations, schedules, documents, and the turnover package handed to the owner at completion.

**Federal use.** Facility Grid is used on federal construction and renovation projects delivered by prime contractors for the US Army Corps of Engineers, the Department of Veterans Affairs, the Department of Energy, the General Services Administration, the US Coast Guard and the Department of Homeland Security. On these projects the commissioning records are contract deliverables owned by the agency, and agency staff or agency-appointed commissioning agents use the platform to review and accept them.

**Scope.** This listing covers the Facility Grid commissioning platform (marketed as FG Construct): the web application, the REST API, and the server-side services behind the iOS and Android apps. It runs on Amazon Web Services in the commercial us-east-2 region. FG Validate and FG Sustain are separate products and are not part of this offering. The mobile apps are installed client software and are outside FedRAMP scope; the services they call are in scope.

**Certification path.** Facility Grid is pursuing a FedRAMP 20x Class A Certification for the existing commercial service on the strength of its SOC 2 Type II examination, and a Class C (Moderate) Certification afterwards, assessed by Insight Assurance.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: Facility Grid Trust Center. Holds the FedRAMP Certification Package (this overview, the Security Decision Record and report samples), the SOC 2 Type II report and bridge letter, the audit engagement record and security policies.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: Open https://trustcenter.facilitygrid.com and choose **Request access**, using your work email address. Requests from .gov and .mil addresses are approved automatically. Other requests, including prime contractors and commissioning agents working for an agency, are reviewed by the Facility Grid security team within 5 business days. Questions go to security@facilitygrid.com.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: The Facility Grid Secure Configuration Guide: how customer administrators securely access, configure, operate and decommission top-level administrative accounts, and what each security-relevant setting does.
secureConfigurationGuidance.accessRequestInstructions: The guide is supplied on request to agencies, their commissioning agents and customer administrators. Email security@facilitygrid.com from your work address, naming your organization; requests from .gov and .mil addresses are answered within 5 business days.

additionalRepositories.repositoryDescription: Public product knowledge base, including administrator guides for roles and permissions, enterprise SSO with Microsoft Entra ID, multi-factor authentication, API access and the project audit log.

Human-readable (PDF) and machine-readable (JSON) versions of this overview, including the quarterly statement of progress toward FedRAMP Certification, published as public documents in the Trust Center with no sign-in required.

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Installation checklists, functional performance tests, issues, observations and site visit reports, with responsibilities assigned to project participants.
Equipment and system inventories organised by building and nested location, including QR-code equipment identification.
Closeout tracking, report generation and the turnover package delivered to the building owner.
Project documents, PDF markup and a company-wide library of reusable templates.
Commissioning tasks, schedules, milestones and Gantt views.
Generates checklists, questionnaires and functional tests from customer content using foundation models on Amazon Bedrock within the same AWS account.
REST API for customer integrations and reporting tools such as Microsoft Power BI.
Optional, customer-enabled synchronisation of issues and project data with the customer's own Procore account.
Sign-in through the customer's own Microsoft Entra ID tenant, with optional SCIM user provisioning.

certified.useCase: AWS US East/West hosts the entire offering in us-east-2: ECS Fargate, Aurora MySQL, DocumentDB, ElastiCache, S3, KMS, WAF, Secrets Manager, SES for transactional email and Bedrock for AI features.
Vanta Trust Management Platform: continuous control monitoring, evidence collection and the Trust Center used to share FedRAMP Certification Data.
Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Commercial Cloud): Facility Grid workforce identity and single sign-on into AWS and internal administrative tools.

nonCertified.name: Procore
nonCertified.useCase: Customer-enabled synchronisation of issues and project data with the customer's commercial Procore account. Procore offers a FedRAMP Authorized edition (FR2516365096); the federal environment planned for Class C will connect to it.

nonCertified.name: LaunchDarkly
nonCertified.useCase: Feature flag configuration only, through an in-VPC relay. No customer data is sent. LaunchDarkly offers a FedRAMP Authorized edition (FR2120962552); the federal environment planned for Class C will use it.

nonCertified.name: Plivo
nonCertified.useCase: Delivery of SMS one-time codes for user two-factor authentication. The recipient phone number and code leave the offering.

nonCertified.name: Slack incoming webhook
nonCertified.useCase: Operational alerts from the application to Facility Grid staff. Slack offers a FedRAMP Authorized edition (FR1823447014).

nonCertified.name: Google Apps Script
nonCertified.useCase: A legacy daily job posts aggregate project statistics to an internal Google Apps Script web app. Scheduled for removal.

certificationProgress.target: FedRAMP 20x Class A Certification for the existing commercial service, followed by FedRAMP 20x Class C (Moderate) Certification.

milestonesReached.milestone: SOC 2 Type II report issued by Asfaleia (Security and Availability; examination period 1 July 2024 to 30 June 2025; unqualified opinion).
Insight Assurance (FedRAMP assessor 203355) engaged for SOC 2 Type II, ISO 27001 and the FedRAMP 20x Class C assessment.
SOC 2 Type II examination opened with Insight Assurance for the period 30 June 2025 to 30 August 2026.
